sources.read_scope: Subscription trigger, top-of-book fields, timestamp and missing continuity proof
findings: event_trigger: bbo or trades; default trades.
bbo: on a change in the best-bid-offer price levels; trades: on every trade.
Payload contains bid, bid_qty, ask, ask_qty and ticker timestamp, as well as rolling trade statistics.
No documented ticker sequence number or book checksum in the examined payload.
limitations: bbo does not document delivery of every size-only update; not complete L1 order-flow history.
Generic Snapshot / Update prose says updates on trade events despite the more specific bbo parameter; future capture must verify acknowledged trigger and observed behavior.
No WebSocket connection, latency measurement or feed-completeness test performed.

sources.read_scope: Trade identity, timestamps, snapshot and side
findings: Trade identifier is a sequence number, unique per book.
Snapshot reflects the most recent 50 trades.
side and ord_type describe the taker order; timestamp is RFC3339.
Timestamps are not unique transaction identifiers.
limitations: Last-50 snapshot is not complete reconnect backfill; upstream loss cannot be repaired or ruled out solely from it.

sources.read_scope: Authoritative v2 symbol/status and precision metadata preflight
findings: instrument snapshot contains pairs with symbol, base, quote, status and precision/increment metadata.
The inspected documentation example is BTC/USD, not evidence that BTC/EUR was subscribed.
limitations: No instrument-channel subscription occurred. Exact BTC/EUR v2 eligibility remains an activation preflight condition.

sources.read_scope: Public endpoint, naming, exact numeric decoding and reconnect guidance
findings: Public v2 endpoint is wss://ws.kraken.com/v2; authentication applies to the separate private endpoint.
v2 uses BTC naming and requires instrument channel to discover supported symbols; REST wsname is v1 naming.
Documentation explicitly recommends decimal or string decoding to preserve price/quantity precision.
Approximately 150 connection attempts per rolling 10 minutes per IP can trigger a 10-minute ban.
limitations: This is access mechanism documentation, not a comprehensive historical retention or redistribution licence.

sources.read_scope: One public REST instrument metadata request, no prices/trades/quotes
findings: error=[]; result key XXBTZEUR; altname XBTEUR; wsname XBT/EUR; base XXBT; quote ZEUR; status online.
limitations: Confirms current listed spot pair at retrieval, not v2 subscription success, historical mapping or access from the eventual Spanish host.

findings: Header: timestamp,price,volume,type,order_type,misc,trade_id.
Fractional Unix seconds; volume in base currency; trade IDs ascend per pair.
Earlier releases used different column order; schema must be verified.
ID gaps expected: allocated IDs sometimes never become public trades. Delisted rows may have empty type/order_type/misc/trade_id.
limitations: No received-at timestamps are present; archive publication time cannot impersonate contemporaneous reception.
